Context: Conditions for grant of benefits :

5. Promotions earned/ upgradation granted under the MACP Scheme in the past to those grades which are in the same Level in the Pay Matrix due to merger of pay scales/upgradations of posts recommended by the Seventh Pay Commission shall be ignored for the purpose of granting upgradations under Modified ACPS. The benefit of merger will accrue with effect from the date of notification of the Recruitment Rules for the relevant post.
